sentences.cn_text: 没有什么行业比得上演艺业——但在洛杉矶,感觉如今根本就没有任何行业。
sentences.en_text: There’s no business like show business — but in Los Angeles, it feels like there’s no business at all.

sentences.cn_text: 如果这听起来过于夸张,不妨考虑以下事实:代表约3000名影视从业者的劳工组织艺术指导工会已暂停了一项培训计划,并发表声明解释称「我们无法昧着良心鼓励你们从事我们的职业」。这是对好莱坞衰退的反应,这种衰退正使该行业和南加州地区走到危急关头。
sentences.en_text: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that “we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession” This is a reaction to Hollywood’s decline, which is reaching a critical point for the industry and Southern California.

sentences.cn_text: 自20世纪50年代以来,影视制作一直在从好莱坞流失,但这种影响从未像现在这样显著。
sentences.en_text: Production has been slipping away from Hollywood since the 1950s, but the effects have never been more apparent than at present.

sentences.cn_text: 美国其他地区、加拿大和欧洲不断加大激励措施以吸引电视节目和电影拍摄,使加州相形见绌。
sentences.en_text: Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust.

sentences.cn_text: 乔治亚州为影视制作成本提供高达30%的可转让税收抵免,如果项目中含有乔治亚州宣传标识,基础税收抵免还将额外增加10%。
sentences.en_text: Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管加州流失了大量制作业务到其他地区,但在今年之前,洛杉矶仍有大量影视制作活动。
sentences.en_text: Even as California lost a huge volume of production to other locations, there was still plenty of film production taking place in Los Angeles before this year.

sentences.cn_text: 我们依靠「巅峰电视时代」维持运转,即流媒体服务爆发式增长所需的海量内容。
sentences.en_text: We were kept afloat by “peak TV” the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services.

sentences.cn_text: 但2022年是巅峰电视时代的顶峰。
sentences.en_text: But 2022 was the peak of peak TV.

sentences.cn_text: 当时Netflix、亚马逊和Apple TV等平台为吸引新订阅用户而大量烧钱制作内容,导致当年共上线了633部剧集。
sentences.en_text: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.

sentences.cn_text: 随着流媒体平台的重心从用户增长转向盈利,服务价格上涨,新剧数量降至2023年的481部,预计几年内将降至300多部。
sentences.en_text: As the streamers’ emphasis changed from subscriber growth to profitability, prices for the services went up and the number of new shows went down to 481 released in 2023, with the number expected to dip into the 300s within a few years.

sentences.cn_text: 如果南加州的影视制作长期跌破临界水平,该行业的核心人才将随巨额收入一同流失。
sentences.en_text: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry’s essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.

sentences.cn_text: 如果我们无法提供实力雄厚的本地影视从业者、荧幕人才以及支持娱乐产业的本地企业,说服制片厂在此拍摄将变得更加困难。
sentences.en_text: Persuading studios to film here would become much more challenging if we couldn’t offer a deep bench of local film workers, on-screen talent and local businesses that support the entertainment industry.

sentences.cn_text: 这就是为什么加州电影委员会及其洛杉矶对口机构Film LA必须在为时已晚之前立即行动。
sentences.en_text: That’s why the California Film Commission and its Los Angeles counterpart, Film LA, now should act, before it’s too late.

sentences.cn_text: 这些机构和其他政府部门应大幅改善激励措施,以留住现有剧集并吸引新制作来洛杉矶。
sentences.en_text: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.

sentences.cn_text: 让演出继续……并确保演出不会在没有我们的情况下继续。
sentences.en_text: Let’s go on with the show...and make sure the show doesn’t go on without us.
